claims.text: DoReMi (arXiv 2305.10429, supplement identity record, NeurIPS 2023) trains 280M proxy/reference models with Group DRO over domains to set mixture weights without downstream knowledge, then trains an 8B model (30x larger) 2.6x faster to baseline accuracy (+6.5pp few-shot on the Pile).
Allocation-as-composition complements Chinchilla quantity scaling in the data-efficiency thesis.
The bound Discovery locator (2308.01833) resolves to an unrelated robotics paper; no claim cites it.
